_doc: RimFlow v3 testing policy tunables (design/RimMandrake/testing_policy_2026-10-28.md; item TESTING_POLICY_DESIGN_RIGHT_TOOL_RIGHT_TIME). Read by src/RimMandrake/rimflow/testing_policy.py (load_policy / param); enforced today only by src/RimMandrake/Utils/mutation/run_mutation.py's full-run gate. The v3 autotuner may change `value` of a param whose provenance is D or A, writing provenance A and a `why` naming the signal it read; O and C params change only on the owner's word. Each param: value, unit, why, provenance, signal (what measurement should move it, and which way).

_provenance.O: owner's own words (quoted in the policy doc)
_provenance.D: current code default nobody has ruled on
_provenance.A: agent proposal from measurement (this doc or the autotuner)

mutation.scope.why: mutation testing only on decision/evidence machinery, where a silently-passing test lets a wrong decision through
mutation.scope.signal: owner only; a new decision-bearing module joins a class, it does not widen the list

mutation.full_min_stable_days.unit: days since the target module's last logic commit
mutation.full_min_stable_days.why: a FULL run only after the file's logic is unchanged >= 3 days; 10-27..10-28 every target was re-mutated 2-3x while it changed (dispatcher 2071->2283->2321 mutants), 32.3 CPU-h in 2 days
mutation.full_min_stable_days.signal: owner only (approved rule); the autotuner may report survivors-invalidated-by-later-edits as evidence

mutation.full_requires_review_clean.why: a FULL run only after the file is code_review_status CLEAN

mutation.score_bar.unit: killed / (mutants - timeouts counted as killed per mutmut)
mutation.score_bar.why: the 85% bar applies to FULL runs only; every survivor triaged (test / equivalent+reason / not-worth-it+reason); equivalent mutants make 100% impossible

mutation.evolving_scope.why: evolving code gets at most a run scoped to changed functions; no score-chasing tests on code in flux

mutation.max_full_runs_per_target_per_we.why: a stable target does not change, so a second full run in a week buys nothing new unless the selftest set changed
mutation.max_full_runs_per_target_per_we.signal: raise if a second run in the week finds survivors the first did not (it should not); lower never

mutation.workers.why: run_mutation.py default; during runs testq cold reload went +12..+21 s on 81 s (n=2) and WSL python +34..39%
mutation.workers.signal: lower if testq phase_s.load during mutation exceeds pre-mutation by >25% over n>=5 jobs; raise if the slice sits idle

mutation.shard_timeout_h.why: run_mutation.py default; a killed shard's recorded results still count
mutation.shard_timeout_h.signal: lower if no shard in 10 runs exceeded half of it

selftest.per_test_timeout_s.unit: seconds (a `# selftest-timeout: N` tag overrides per file)
selftest.per_test_timeout_s.why: run_selftests.py PER_TEST_TIMEOUT_S; 4 tests at ~600 s are 41% of the 5,818 test-seconds of the 2026-10-28 sweep
selftest.per_test_timeout_s.signal: a test over 120 s for 3 nights is a split/move-to-tier candidate, not a timeout raise

selftest.slow_test_flag_s.why: 25 of 742 tests ran > 30 s and the top 20 are 64% of sweep test-seconds
selftest.slow_test_flag_s.signal: lower when the nightly wall exceeds 20 min; raise when it is under 10 min

selftest.known_red_after_nights.why: the nightly sweep was RED 14 of 14 nights (2026-10-15..28); 14 tests red >= 5 nights, selftest_handoff red 14/14, so RED carries no news. A test red this many nights must hold an open item and be listed as known-red, so a new red stands out
selftest.known_red_after_nights.signal: lower if new reds are missed among known ones; raise never above 7

selftest.red_first_for_bug_fixes.why: a fix's test must fail on the unfixed code first, or it may test nothing
selftest.red_first_for_bug_fixes.signal: owner may relax per area; keep while red-first tests keep catching harness bugs

code_review.full_review_quiet_hours.unit: hours since the file's last edit before a full-file review is spent
code_review.full_review_quiet_hours.why: since 2026-10-14, 7,057 clean marks over 4,158 paths; 1,246 paths re-reviewed >= 2x and 326 >= 4x (Program.cs 28x). A review of a file still being edited is spent again within the day. Not a rule against reviewing: CLEAN is still required before mark-clean and before diff-scoped review
code_review.full_review_quiet_hours.signal: raise if paths with cleanCount >= 4 in 14 days stay above 5% of cleaned paths; lower if review backlog blocks commits

gpt_review.max_rounds_before_conditional.unit: rounds whose only findings are weak/partial, already through fix rounds
gpt_review.max_rounds_before_conditional.why: "Hours producing no issues, or only partial/weak issues that have had multiple rounds of attempting to fix them already, produce a conditional pass... and that's ok." (owner 2026-10-25, by card); rounds-until-zero stops there
gpt_review.max_rounds_before_conditional.signal: owner only for the rule; the count is A-tunable: raise if a round after the 3rd found a HIGH in >1 of the last 10 designs

art_eval.regen_rounds_before_escalate.signal: lower if round 3 succeeds <10% of the time

testq.fill_hours.unit: lane hours per local day for filler guard jobs (TESTQ_FILL_HOURS)
testq.fill_hours.why: 2026-10-26..28: 247 guard jobs (236 filler) used 27.8 of 44.6 lane-hours and yielded 2 findings (0.07/lane-h) vs fix 2.2/lane-h, sweep 3.5/lane-h; 2026-10-29: lowered 20 -> 8 (TESTQ_FILLER_GUARD_TUNE_LOW_YIELD), re-check after 7 days
testq.fill_hours.signal: lower while guard findings/lane-h < 0.25 over 7 days; filler is cheap only when nothing else waits for the lane

testq.sweep_hour_local.unit: local time, nightly modcheck sweep per TESTQ_SWEEP_MODS
testq.sweep_hour_local.why: testq-sweep.timer; 9 sweeps yielded 17 findings in 4.8 lane-h (best yield per lane-hour measured)
testq.sweep_hour_local.signal: keep while findings/sweep >= 1; drop to every 2nd night if 5 sweeps in a row find nothing new

live.cold_load_full_list_min.unit: minutes (MEASURED 2026-09-07); minimal 13-mod list 22 s; quicktest map ~90 s
live.cold_load_full_list_min.why: a cold load is the most expensive test we run; batch it, never 'restart and see'

live.flyer_flight_without_owner.why: "do not do live testing of flyers without a human present. It doesn't work."

ops.deadman_period_min.why: outside dead-man for the Dispatcher and ops_watch; no AI, near-zero cost
ops.deadman_period_min.signal: lower only if a dispatcher stall went unnoticed longer than 2 periods

ops.ops_watch_period_min.why: deterministic measurement arm for Operations; no AI
ops.ops_watch_period_min.signal: raise if its alarms are mostly repeats of an open item
